digest.component_or_area: ticket plan review and clarity validation framework
propositions: Six proposed deterministic clarity criteria were tested against 574 closed tickets with signed plan-review and completion-verifier attestations to identify false positives.

Mandatory canonical section headings (Approach, Scope, Testing) cannot be enforced literally because valid plans express equivalent content via semantic aliases, compact inline descriptions, or headings-agnostic vocabulary.

Placeholder-detection lexicon rules (check if, TBD, design choice markers) produce false positives on bounded conditionals that are mechanically decidable and fully specified despite the flagged phrase.

Per-AC explicit proof-coverage markers (verified by, verify with) cannot be required as a hard oracle because behavioral assertions and precision oracles often omit marker sentinels yet remain sound and plan-review-validated.
Edit-set requirements with grounded file_impact conflict with valid read-only analysis, operational probe, and external-attestation work when an explicit no-edit output contract is documented.

AC conjunction counts, negative-scenario taxonomy enforcement, and vague-hedge detection should be downgraded from validity criteria to advisory signals because they conflate syntactic patterns with semantic coherence and misapply per-heading rules to work categories where they are inapplicable.
